description: This Lua source file provides functions for parsing documentation comments from code, extracting parameters, descriptions, examples, and generating method declarations. It is part of a documentation or code analysis system for a project that uses Lua for documentation parsing.

methods.name: from_md
methods.description: Replaces inline code markers '`' in markdown text with HTML code tags, toggling between and .

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter string from documentation comments into a table with name and description.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts the main description text from comment block, filtering out special tags.

methods.name: parse_bottom_description
methods.description: Extracts the bottom part of the description from comment block, excluding param sections and handling example blocks.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Parses the @return annotation from comment, extracting variable name and description.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Extracts example code snippets from comment, including live examples and optional call index.

methods.name: parse_calls
methods.description: Extracts function call information and arguments from comment annotations.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Parses a documentation comment block into a structured method or event representation with description, examples, parameters, and calls.

methods.name: get_declaration
methods.description: Constructs a string representing a function call with parameter names.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Generates declarations for each call variation of a method.

methods.name: parse_params
methods.description: Extracts all @param annotations from comment into parameter tables.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses the source code to extract documented methods and callback methods with their associated documentation.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Strips HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Processes header files in a directory to extract documented modules and their methods.
